reported_observation: Across six protocol implementations, the full two-phase analysis averages 1123K input tokens, 90K output tokens, USD 5.03, and 81 minutes per protocol.
unit_or_comparison: tokens, USD per protocol, minutes per protocol
source_location: Paper Sec. IV-D and Table V, pp. 10--11
synthesis_use: Shows that repository semantic indexing and retrieval incur measurable per-target cost rather than a model-only accuracy effect.

reported_observation: Removing semantic indexing lowers precision from 81.9% to 51.4% and detected bugs from 47 to 26; removing retrieval lowers precision to 47.1% and detected bugs to 36.
source_location: Paper Sec. IV-E and Table VI, pp. 11--12
synthesis_use: Attributes performance to context construction and retrieval interfaces, not only to the backbone model.

reported_observation: Hierarchical seed generation reaches 92%/81% instruction coverage on small/large contracts versus 65%/56% for random-seed GA and 87%/77% for flat LLM generation; throughput falls from 125 to 98 transactions/s relative to GA.
source_location: Paper Sec. V-C and Table VII, p. 3293
synthesis_use: Shows a coverage-throughput tradeoff from workflow structure and hierarchical prompting.

reported_observation: The full dual-channel recovery reaches 92%/81% coverage, compared with 79%/71% for LLM reseeding without selective symbolic execution and 89%/78% for symbolic execution without LLM reseeding.
source_location: Paper Sec. V-C and Table IX, pp. 3293--3294
synthesis_use: Separates the contribution of semantic reseeding from fixed symbolic recovery.

reported_observation: The paper reports an average LLM cost of USD 1.83 per PoV under its benchmark configuration.
synthesis_use: Provides a per-result cost unit but is not directly comparable with per-package or per-protocol reporting.

reported_observation: The REFLECT phase separates non-reaching executions from reach-but-no-trigger cases, using deviation detection for the former and debugger-assisted backward dependency analysis for the latter.
unit_or_comparison: qualitative failure categories and recovery actions
synthesis_use: Shows that failure reuse depends on preserving constraint and execution state, not merely retrying.

reported_observation: AI-ExploitGen averages about 656 tokens per exploit, compared with 1650 for Gemini-1.5-Pro and 2392 for Claude Opus 4 in the reported evaluation.
source_location: Paper Sec. IV and Fig. 2, p. 85
synthesis_use: Illustrates token reporting at exploit level; no cross-study cost conversion is attempted.

reported_observation: The reported average is USD 0.089 per package, USD 0.084 per successfully exploited package, and an amortized USD 0.050 per valid exploit.
unit_or_comparison: USD per package or valid exploit
synthesis_use: Shows that one study can expose several cost denominators that should not be collapsed.

reported_observation: Manual review rejects some oracle-passing PoCs because they rely on unrealistic stubs, files, environment changes, internal APIs, or external user interaction; large irrelevant context also contributes to misses.
synthesis_use: Separates automated oracle success from valid exploitability and identifies context-selection failures.

reported_observation: Across a 13-target subset, backbone comparisons show stage-specific completion differences and substantial time/cost variation; the paper reports all models at 100% vulnerability-analysis completion but divergent reconnaissance and exploitation results.
unit_or_comparison: stage completion, seconds, and USD by model
synthesis_use: Shows that model choice affects stages differently inside a fixed multi-agent workflow.

reported_observation: Failures cluster in intelligence gathering and exploitation and include coarse service identification, missing domain knowledge, required user interaction, and hallucination cascades.
synthesis_use: Connects persistent execution history and human intervention points to concrete long-horizon failure modes.

reported_observation: The framework treats CPU, memory, and LLM spending as bounded runtime resources; LiteLLM enforces per-CRS budgets and rejects requests beyond the configured allowance.
unit_or_comparison: budget controls rather than a normalized evaluation cost
synthesis_use: Shows that deployment cost can be a runtime control interface even when a study does not report comparable per-result cost.
